title: Parry Fling | Helicopter High Jump | HHJ
script:
-- kinda vibe coded
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local Player = Players.LocalPlayer
local Camera = workspace.CurrentCamera

repeat task.wait() until Camera.CameraType == Enum.CameraType.Custom

-- Main ScreenGui
local screenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
screenGui.Name = "HHJ_Macro_Hub"
screenGui.ResetOnSpawn = false
screenGui.Parent = Player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

-- Helper Function to Create Stylish Rounded Drag Frames
local function createStyledCard(pos, size)
    local frame = Instance.new("Frame")
    frame.Size = size
    frame.Position = pos
    frame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(35, 35, 45)
    frame.BorderSizePixel = 0
    frame.Active = true
    frame.Draggable = true
    frame.Parent = screenGui

    local uiCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
    uiCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 12)
    uiCorner.Parent = frame

    local uiGradient = Instance.new("UIGradient")
    uiGradient.Color = ColorSequence.new({
        ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, Color3.fromRGB(45, 45, 60)),
        ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, Color3.fromRGB(20, 20, 30))
    })
    uiGradient.Rotation = 45
    uiGradient.Parent = frame

    local uiStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
    uiStroke.Thickness = 1.5
    uiStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(80, 80, 110)
    uiStroke.ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border
    uiStroke.Parent = frame

    return frame
end

-- Core Functionality Definitions
local function tiltCharacter45()
    local char = Player.Character
    if not char then return end
    local humanoidRoot = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not humanoidRoot then return end

    local originalCF = humanoidRoot.CFrame
    local tiltCF = CFrame.Angles(math.rad(90), 0, 0)
    humanoidRoot.CFrame = CFrame.new(originalCF.Position) * tiltCF * originalCF.Rotation
end

local isSpinning = false
local function rotateCamera(deg)
    local root = Player.Character and Player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not root then return end
    local newCFrame = CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(deg), 0) * Camera.CFrame
    Camera.CFrame = CFrame.new(Camera.CFrame.Position) * newCFrame.Rotation
end

local function runSpinSequence(duration)
    if isSpinning then return end
    isSpinning = true
    local startTime = tick()

    task.spawn(function()
        while tick() - startTime < duration do
            rotateCamera(-180)
            RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
            rotateCamera(180)
            RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
        end
        isSpinning = false
    end)
end

----------------------------------------------------
-- 1. MANUAL TILT CARD
----------------------------------------------------
local tiltFrame = createStyledCard(UDim2.new(0.5, -230, 0.1, 0), UDim2.new(0, 210, 0, 60))

local tiltButton = Instance.new("TextButton")
tiltButton.Size = UDim2.new(1, -16, 1, -16)
tiltButton.Position = UDim2.new(0, 8, 0, 8)
tiltButton.BackgroundTransparency = 1
tiltButton.Text = "↯ HHJ Tilter\n(Replicates Mars Jump)"
tiltButton.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(240, 240, 255)
tiltButton.TextScaled = true
tiltButton.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
tiltButton.Parent = tiltFrame

tiltButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(tiltCharacter45)

----------------------------------------------------
-- 2. HHJ SPINNER & AUTO CARD
----------------------------------------------------
local mainCard = createStyledCard(UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.1, 0), UDim2.new(0, 250, 0, 200))

-- Auto HHJ Toggle Button
local autoEnabled = false
local autoToggleBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
autoToggleBtn.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 32)
autoToggleBtn.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 10)
autoToggleBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(150, 50, 50)
autoToggleBtn.BorderSizePixel = 0
autoToggleBtn.Text = "Helicopter High Jump Auto: OFF"
autoToggleBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
autoToggleBtn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
autoToggleBtn.TextSize = 11
autoToggleBtn.Parent = mainCard

local autoCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
autoCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)
autoCorner.Parent = autoToggleBtn

-- Auto Sequence Delay Setting Input
local delayLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
delayLabel.Size = UDim2.new(0.65, -10, 0, 25)
delayLabel.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 48)
delayLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
delayLabel.Text = "Auto Delay (s):"
delayLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 200, 220)
delayLabel.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
delayLabel.Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium
delayLabel.TextSize = 12
delayLabel.Parent = mainCard

local delayInput = Instance.new("TextBox")
delayInput.Size = UDim2.new(0.35, -15, 0, 25)
delayInput.Position = UDim2.new(0.65, 5, 0, 48)
delayInput.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(20, 20, 25)
delayInput.BorderSizePixel = 0
delayInput.Text = "0.025"
delayInput.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(100, 255, 150)
delayInput.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
delayInput.TextSize = 12
delayInput.Parent = mainCard

local delayCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
delayCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)
delayCorner.Parent = delayInput

-- Spin Active Duration Setting Input
local durationLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
durationLabel.Size = UDim2.new(0.65, -10, 0, 25)
durationLabel.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 78)
durationLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
durationLabel.Text = "Spin Active (s):"
durationLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 200, 220)
durationLabel.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
durationLabel.Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium
durationLabel.TextSize = 12
durationLabel.Parent = mainCard

local durationInput = Instance.new("TextBox")
durationInput.Size = UDim2.new(0.35, -15, 0, 25)
durationInput.Position = UDim2.new(0.65, 5, 0, 78)
durationInput.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(20, 20, 25)
durationInput.BorderSizePixel = 0
durationInput.Text = "3.5"
durationInput.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(100, 255, 150)
durationInput.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
durationInput.TextSize = 12
durationInput.Parent = mainCard

local durCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
durCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)
durCorner.Parent = durationInput

-- Manual Trigger Button
local spinButton = Instance.new("TextButton")
spinButton.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 50)
spinButton.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 135)
spinButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(60, 60, 90)
spinButton.BorderSizePixel = 0
spinButton.Text = "Parry/HHJ Macro"
spinButton.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
spinButton.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
spinButton.TextSize = 15
spinButton.Parent = mainCard

local btnCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
btnCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)
btnCorner.Parent = spinButton

local btnGradient = Instance.new("UIGradient")
btnGradient.Color = ColorSequence.new({
    ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, Color3.fromRGB(90, 80, 200)),
    ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, Color3.fromRGB(50, 40, 120))
})
btnGradient.Parent = spinButton

-- Auto Toggle Logic
autoToggleBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    autoEnabled = not autoEnabled
    if autoEnabled then
        autoToggleBtn.Text = "Helicopter High Jump Auto: ON"
        autoToggleBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(50, 150, 50)
    else
        autoToggleBtn.Text = "Helicopter High Jump Auto: OFF"
        autoToggleBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(150, 50, 50)
    end
end)

-- Execute Function handling sequence
local function executeHHJ()
    local duration = tonumber(durationInput.Text) or 3.5
    local delayTime = tonumber(delayInput.Text) or 0.025

    if autoEnabled then
        tiltCharacter45()
        task.wait(delayTime)
    end

    runSpinSequence(duration)
end

spinButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(executeHHJ)
